full_judgment:
ABM Khairul Haque J: This Rule Nisi was issued under Article 102 of the Constitution of the People's Republic of Bangladesh at the instance of Dr Md Alamgir, calling upon the Vice Chancellor, Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (BUET) and another to show cause as to why they should not be directed for finalisation of selection and appointment of the petitioner to the post of Assistant Professor, in the Department of Civil Engineering, BUET, as recommended by the Selection Board, in pursuance to the advertisement published on 19-4-2001, issued by the respondent No.2 and as to why Ad-hoc appointment made by the respondent Nos. 1 and 2 to the post of Assistant Professor, Department of Civil Engineering, BUET in favour of respondent Nos. 3 and 4, issued under the signature of respondent No.2 (Annexure F and G) should not be declared to have been made without lawful authority and is of no legal effect. On the prayer of the petitioner, there was an order of stay for regularisation of appointments of the respondent Nos. 3 and 4. 

 2. The facts of the case, in brief, is that in response to an advertisement published on 19-4-2000 by the Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology (University) for appointment in the post of Assistant Professor, Department of Civil Engineering, the petitioner filed an application on 25-4-2000 which was duly forwarded to the University by the Director, Bangladesh Institute of Technology (BIT), Khulna. The petitioner was called on for an interview and he duly appeared before the Selection Board of the University on 11-6-2000 with other candidates. Subsequently, the petitioner came to know that he had been recommended for the said post of Assistant Professor in the Department of Civil Engineering by the Selection Board and he topped the list of the candidates on merit. After such selection the matter was placed before the syndicate of the University for appointment and the matter was taken up for consideration by the Syndicate in its meeting held on 14-6-2000 along with the proposals for other appointees of other Departments and although the appointments in other Departments were approved as recommended by the Selection Committees but the appointment in the post of Assistant Professor in the Department of the Civil Engineering was stayed. Rather, this matter was not taken -up in the subsequent meetings of the syndicate although appointment of other Departments were being duly considered by the Syndicate from time to time. As such the petitioner through his learned Advocate issued a Notice for demand of justice on 11-10-2000, for appointment to the post of Assistant Professor in the Department of Civil Engineering but the respondents instead, filled up the two posts of Assistant Professors in the Department of Civil Engineering by the respondent Nos. 3 and 4 on an ad hoc basis. Because of the delay in finalisation of the appointment and also on the appointments of the respondent Nos. 3 and 4, being apprehensive that ultimately the petitioner might be dropped and they may be appointed permanently in the posts of Assistant Professor, he obtained the present Rule. 

 15. After due advertisement, candidates are selected by the Selection Board of the University. The Selection Board also consists of highly educated and responsible persons. It appears in this case that after due selection, the Syndicate failed to take any decision in respect of the appointments in the two posts of Assistant Professors, rather sat on it for months together, apparently without any reason, although similar decisions are being taken in respect of other Departments.
